people.name: Bethlehem
people.line: City of David's birth and Jesus' birth.

translations.web: His concubine played the prostitute against him, and went away from him to her father’s house to Bethlehem Judah, and was there for four months.
translations.bsb: But she was unfaithful to him and left him to return to her father’s house in Bethlehem in Judah. After she had been there four months,
translations.kjv: And his concubine played the whore against him, and went away from him unto her father's house to Bethlehemjudah, and was there four whole months.
translations.asv: And his concubine played the harlot against him, and went away from him unto her father's house to Beth-lehem-judah, and was there the space of four months.
